name: Sectra AB (publ)
summary: Sectra AB (publ) provides solutions for medical IT and cybersecurity sectors in Sweden, the United Kingdom, the United States, rest of Europe, and internationally. The company operates through Imaging IT Solutions, Secure Communications, Business Innovation, and Other Operations. The Imaging IT Solutions segment develops and sells medical IT systems and services for diagnostics, managing, archiving, presenting, and communicating various types of medical images and patient information, as well as for operational follow-up and radiation dose monitoring; and maintenance in the form of support, system monitoring, and consulting services.
